name: VLM-Augmented Segmentation
definition: An approach augmenting each 3D Gaussian with compact language features distilled from a knowledge-enhanced medical VLM via a scene-specific autoencoder, enabling open-vocabulary 3D segmentation.
summary: VLM-Augmented Segmentation enables open-vocabulary 3D segmentation by distilling VLM embeddings into compact latent attributes via a scene-specific autoencoder, reducing memory usage while preserving volumetric consistency.
